_comment: CCV-L23's declared table (DA rev 131 form; DA 130, OI-184's lag-1 option) for ooe_redir.sv's PWV form: each slot's redirect, written in its resolution's cycle and read by the send when the slot has waited.

ft_cq04h.why: ooe_redir's waiting redirects (S words, one a slot): a resolution writes its slot's word from ooe_rob_w's cq03h payload; the send, at its own stage, reads a word through pi_cq03h only when that slot waited, an arriving slot's payload being the ports'. Neither a loop's back edge nor a later copy on the reader's pipeline. To be signed by OA in OI's landing row.
